title: Validation sets
name: Set name
deleteConfirm: Delete this set and all run history? Export first; this cannot be undone.
empty: Create or select a set, upload field images and edit expectations.
scope: Single-image checks compare class, count, confidence and optional plate text. Temporal algorithms require video validation. Sets are stored on this gateway and shared by both entrances.
preview: Select an image to inspect its detections
categoryHint: Empty matches all classes, e.g. person
comparisonHelp: Count valid objects matching class, confidence and optional text. Composite recognition such as licence plates uses the final recognition confidence, and explicitly hidden low-confidence candidates are excluded. Exact count passes; zero means no matching objects. Box locations are not evaluated.
upload: Click or drop to upload field images in bulk
limits: JPG / PNG / WebP, ≤ 4 MB and 16 megapixels each; up to 50 images
defaultExpected: New images expect zero objects by default; review each expectation
emptySamples: No images or matching results; upload images or adjust filters
upgrade: This gateway needs an upgrade to support validation sets
removeConfirm: Remove this image from the set? Historical runs are retained.
